thesis: CROX re-rated on the 2026-10-29 Q3 print (gap to 150.26 on about 4x volume). It has held above the 149.5 base since then while QQQ fell, backed by accelerating earnings (net income +48.65% YoY), high margins and a forward P/E of 9.92. A pullback entry in the 154.5-158.5 zone with the technical stop at 148.8 gives R/R of 2.9 at the mid entry of 156.5, or 2.0 at the last price of 158.79, toward the 178.98 measured-move target. It is rated Overweight, not Buy, because the regime is risk-off (confidence 0.85, TNX 5.115), the stock is 9.2% above SMA20 after a +32% 21-day run, and the 164.24 52-week high that was rejected on 11-16 sits only about 1R overhead. Stop, target and zone are unchanged from the technical card. Entry is the zone midpoint. The last price of 158.79 is just above the zone, so this is pullback-only and fills should be logged. News feeds were available. There is no sentiment card (Phase 3 not active).
invalidation: Daily close below 149.5 (the post-earnings base low), or a failure back under the 150 gap area on rising volume.
